description: This file defines multiple protocols for service interfaces related to device functionalities such as camera, screen recording, location, device status, photos, contacts, calendar, reminders, motion, and watch messaging. It also includes typealiases and some data structures for results and status information, and provides extension conformances for certain classes to these protocols.

classes.name: CameraController
classes.description: Extension conforming CameraController to CameraServicing protocol

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Extension conforming ScreenRecordService to ScreenRecordingServicing protocol

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Extension conforming LocationService to LocationServicing protocol
